Read the developer's name, email, and portfolio address from 'prozilla.md' inside the Documents folder. Change the content of 'text.txt' to organize this information in the format 'Name: [name], Email: [email], Portfolio: [portfolio]' and save the file. Keep the file open.

task_name: Terminal create, Explorer verify: incident folder scaffold.
instruction: Use Terminal to go into Documents and create an incident_a workspace with logs and notes folders, then create app.log and todo.txt and list the structure. After that, open File Explorer, navigate to Documents/incident_a, and make sure both logs and notes are visible. Leave the application open.

task_name: Terminal archive build, Explorer verify extracted files.
instruction: In Terminal, move to Documents, prepare pack032 with a.txt and b.txt, compress them into pack032.zip, extract into unpack032, and show the extracted tree. Then open File Explorer at Documents/unpack032/pack032 and confirm a.txt and b.txt are there. Leave the application open.

task_name: Terminal zip restore, Explorer verify evidence set.
instruction: Create a zip archive containing two log files (1.log and 2.log) inside ~/Documents/ev033, then extract this archive to a new directory named ev033_restore using the Terminal. Finally, verify that both restored files exist in the destination using File Explorer. Leave the application open.

task_name: Terminal rename and move, Explorer verify final location.
instruction: In Terminal under Documents, create flow034/inbox and flow034/done, make note.txt in inbox, move and rename it to final_note.txt inside done, and print the directory tree. Next, open File Explorer at Documents/flow034/done and verify final_note.txt is present. Leave the application open.

task_name: Terminal permission update, Explorer verify file exists.
instruction: Use Terminal in Documents to create secure035.txt, change its permission to 600, and print file paths so the file appears in output. Then open File Explorer in Documents and confirm secure035.txt exists. Leave the application open.

task_name: Terminal sort result, Explorer verify output artifact.
instruction: In Terminal from Documents, create ranks036.txt with values 30, 10, and 20, sort it numerically into ranks036_sorted.txt, and preview the sorted result. Then open File Explorer in Documents and verify ranks036_sorted.txt exists. Leave the application open.

task_name: Terminal unique filter, Explorer verify dedup output.
instruction: Using Terminal in Documents, create colors037.txt with repeated values, generate a deduplicated file colors037_unique.txt using uniq, and display count metrics for that file. Then open File Explorer in Documents and make sure colors037_unique.txt is present. Leave the application open.

task_name: Terminal nested creation, Explorer verify deep path.
instruction: In Terminal, create a deep nested path deep038/a/b/c inside Documents, add end.txt at the deepest level, and print the tree. Then open File Explorer at Documents/deep038/a/b/c and confirm end.txt is visible. Leave the application open.

task_name: Terminal cleanup operation, Explorer verify removal.
instruction: From Terminal in Documents, create clean039/tmp.txt, remove tmp.txt, and print the clean039 tree. Afterward, open File Explorer at Documents/clean039 and verify tmp.txt is no longer present. Leave the application open.

task_name: Terminal disk note prep, Explorer verify report file.
instruction: In Terminal, generate disk040.txt in Documents by writing disk usage info and a Documents size summary, then preview the report. Open File Explorer in Documents and confirm disk040.txt exists. Leave the application open.

task_name: Explorer create folder and file, Terminal verify tree.
instruction: In File Explorer, create a folder named fx041 under Documents, create todo.txt inside it, and write ship-it. Then verify from Terminal by showing the folder tree and file content. Leave the application open.

task_name: Explorer duplicate file, Terminal verify both copies.
instruction: In File Explorer, create fx042_source.txt in Documents with text copy-me, then create a copy named fx042_copy.txt. Verify from Terminal that both files exist and display count output for both. Leave the application open.

task_name: Explorer rename workflow, Terminal verify final name.
instruction: In File Explorer, create fx043_draft.txt in Documents and rename it to fx043_final.txt. Then use Terminal to confirm the final name can be listed and resolved. Leave the application open.

task_name: Explorer move file to folder, Terminal verify location.
instruction: In File Explorer, create folder fx044_bin and file fx044_note.txt in Documents, then move fx044_note.txt into fx044_bin. Verify in Terminal with both tree and find output for fx044_bin. Leave the application open.

task_name: Explorer build small dataset, Terminal verify sorting.
instruction: In File Explorer, create fx045_numbers.txt in Documents with three lines: 9, 1, and 5. Then use Terminal to sort the file numerically and also show the first line. Leave the application open.

task_name: Explorer create notes, Terminal verify archive creation.
instruction: In File Explorer, create Documents/fx046_notes with files a.txt and b.txt (any short text in each). Then in Terminal, create a zip archive from those two files, list the archive, and print the folder tree. Leave the application open.

task_name: Explorer remove one file, Terminal verify cleanup result.
instruction: In File Explorer, create Documents/fx047 with keep.txt and drop.txt, then delete drop.txt. In Terminal, verify cleanup by showing the tree and listing keep.txt. Leave the application open.

task_name: Explorer create report file, Terminal verify line metrics.
instruction: In File Explorer, create Documents/fx048_report.txt with two lines: status ok and owner ops. Then verify in Terminal by running wc on the file and printing its last line. Leave the application open.

task_name: Refactor a nested folder layout, then verify structure.
instruction: In File Explorer, set up Documents/ref049 with subfolders raw and final, create a.txt and b.txt in raw, move both files to final by drag and drop, and rename raw to archive. Then verify in Terminal with tree and find on ref049/final. Leave the application open.

task_name: Run a fail-then-recover file check workflow.
instruction: In Terminal, first try to list missing050.txt in Documents so it fails. Then create missing050.txt in Documents using File Explorer, return to Terminal, and verify it now lists correctly and has wc output. Leave the application open.
